newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 7.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the U.S. Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 1.15 points to 6,944.70 in cautious trading ahead of key wage and payrolls data on Friday.
* In Kuala Lumpur the benchmark Composite Index lost 2.44 points to close at 1,249.84 after a short-lived rebound failed to take hold.
* Investors were also waiting for news from DRB-Hicom group after the market close on Thursday. The group named Saleh Sulong to replace the late industrialist Yahaya Ahmad.
* Seven stocks of the DRB-Hicom group as well as two others related to Yahaya will requote on Monday.
* Carlsberg 1996 net profit 91.69 million ringgit vs 77.04 million.
* Technology Resources Industries expected to release 1996 results after market close on Friday. Pre-tax profit expected to be around 350 million ringgit.
* Civil engineer Loh & Loh lists stock. Offering 4.80 million shares at 2.80 ringgit each.
